research.research_brief: Conduct comprehensive literature review on software release audit processes and compliance frameworks to ensure all downstream assertions are met before release approval
research.prior_art: Prior art includes ISO/IEC 20000-1 service management standards, ITIL release management processes, and DevOps compliance frameworks that establish audit requirements, documentation procedures, and rollback protocols for software releases

plan: Review ISO/IEC 20000-1 standards for service management audit requirements
Analyze ITIL release management processes for documentation and rollback protocols
Evaluate DevOps compliance frameworks for software release audit procedures
Compile comprehensive literature review findings into audit report
Verify all downstream assertions are satisfied before release approval
Update release documentation with audit findings and compliance measures
Obtain human sign-off on audit approval and compliance validation
Execute release if audit verdict is approve, otherwise initiate rollback procedure
